standard: FlowSmith Comprehensive Coverage Matrix V3 (Rule 29: Strictly Disaggregated Parity)

1_native_coverage.description: First-class native Python connectors with custom OAuth2, schemas, and search

5_mcp_capability.description: Model Context Protocol dynamic agentic tool servers connected at runtime

7_trigger_coverage.description: Dedicated trigger nodes with cursor/webhook checkpointing

8_search_coverage.description: First-class search/query operations supported on all searchable connectors

9_webhook_coverage.description: Real-time webhook listener verification with signature validation

10_authentication_coverage.description: OAuth2, API Key, Bearer, Basic Auth schemes supported without mock authentication

11_pagination_coverage.description: Cursor, page-number, and offset pagination supported across all list operations

12_dynamic_schema_coverage.description: Pydantic V2 schema introspection on all connector operations
